goal.objective: Activate the canonical StegVerse single-heartbeat runtime continuously on a StegVerse-owned or StegVerse-federated node using only node-local durable storage and native process supervision.
success_predicates: A sovereign continuous carrier runs the canonical runtime
Restart/replacement preserves heartbeat and worker state
No external scheduler or process host owns worker activation
failure_predicates: A third-party platform becomes a required production dependency
The worker repeats observation-only failure instead of deriving or escalating solution work

task.derivation_reason: Production activation must remain actively worker-owned and solution-executing; constraints derive solution/escalation work rather than passive stopping states. PR #117 removed the hand-created declaration deadlock for an already-running local heartbeat source. Issue #160 separately closes the earlier initiation circularity by adding a pre-heartbeat entry point that can derive local eligibility, materialize/start the canonical native service, and invoke the nine-predicate verifier without requiring a resident heartbeat to exist first.

eligible_node_declaration: DERIVED_LOCAL_RUNTIME_ELIGIBILITY when canonical engine_v11 + installer + verifier are locally present, durable state is writable, and hosted-environment rejection passes
SELF_BOOTSTRAP_LOCAL_RUNTIME_ELIGIBILITY from scripts/bootstrap_sovereign_runtime.py before heartbeat existence

self_bootstrap_dependency.purpose: Initiate sovereign carrier creation before a resident heartbeat exists by proving local canonical source plus writable durable state, deriving a non-authorizing node declaration, invoking the existing native installer, and immediately invoking the canonical nine-predicate verifier.
self_bootstrap_dependency.source_release_condition: PR #160 dependency implementation merges and exact merged-main validation passes
self_bootstrap_dependency.live_completion_condition: node-local activation.latest.json reports all nine predicates true

completion.next_authorized_action: Validate and merge issue #160's pre-heartbeat self-bootstrap dependency. After source release, any eligible local StegVerse-controlled machine containing the canonical source can initiate materialization/native service startup and nine-predicate verification without requiring a resident heartbeat to pre-exist. G18 remains the canonical live heartbeat owner once the carrier is running.
terminal_when: A continuously executing sovereign heartbeat carrier is active
No duplicate claim or fence exists

constraint.owner: issue #160 owns only the pre-heartbeat bootstrap dependency; SHWP-DURABLE-RUNTIME-ACTIVATION / repository-owner resolver / G18 retains live runtime ownership
solution_candidates: self-bootstrap canonical local source into native supervised carrier
reuse an existing eligible sovereign node
new node from repository-local runtime capsule
constraint.next_solution_detail: PR #117 solved node-declaration derivation after local heartbeat source is already executing; issue #160 closes the remaining initiation circularity by providing a pre-heartbeat bootstrap that derives eligibility, installs/starts native supervision, and invokes the same verifier.
constraint.machine_observable_completion_condition: node-local activation.latest.json reports all nine predicates true
constraint.escalation_rule: after bootstrap source release, escalate only if canonical local source is incomplete, durable state is not writable, native OS supervision cannot be installed, or the execution surface is hosted/non-sovereign
